topic:
Boi canh: dang tren nhanh feature/da-nguoi-dung, da chot xong thiet ke ky thuat Lat 3 (nen phan quyen - users/teams/team_members/team_feature_visibility/app_config/audit_log, ham authorize() mot cong vao, 20 route) - xem CR-20260913-nen-tang-da-nguoi-dung.md muc 6.2/6.3 hien tai (DA duoc sua theo Lat 3) va docs/exchanges/2026-09-19.md cho toan bo qua trinh. Day la vong THIET KE KY THUAT cho LAT 4 (FR 15-20, 46, 48 mot phan) - KHONG PHAI code that, khong sua file code.

Doc that ky: CR muc 6.3 (da co san: buoc di tru 7 buoc, bang project_task_assignments doi sang tro user_id, cot legacy_pic_label, them team_id vao bang nghiep vu, them owner_user_id cho du lieu ca nhan). Doc lai FR-15 den FR-20 day du. Doc CODE THAT hien co de biet dung hinh dang du lieu that: server/routes/projects.ts (task tree 3 cap, parentId, rollup), server/lib/mappers.ts (mapProjectTasksWithCalculatedRollups - rollup % theo estimate hours), server/db.ts (schema hien tai cua projects/project_tasks/project_task_assignments/pics), va cac bang lien quan task ca nhan (tasks), mindmaps.

NHIEM VU:
1) Schema chi tiet cho Lat 4: chinh xac cot nao them vao bang nao (team_id cho projects/project_tasks qua project/weekly_goals/release config; owner_user_id cho tasks/mindmaps; legacy_pic_label; project_task_assignments doi pic-string sang user_id that). Ghi ro cach ALTER TABLE an toan voi du lieu that dang co (khong mat du lieu), dung khuon PRAGMA table_info + ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN da co trong server/db.ts.
2) Ke hoach di tru PIC sang User chi tiet: hop dong tung buoc trong 7 buoc da liet o CR muc 6.3, dac biet buoc 5 (chuyen truong assignee dang chuoi tu do, vi du gom nhieu ten cach nhau boi dau phay, sang legacy_pic_label, KHONG doan tai khoan) - viet ro script/ham nao lam viec nay, kiem tra tinh toan ven the nao (buoc 6).
3) FR-16/FR-17 (nhieu nguoi phu trach, mau Gantt): xac nhan schema project_task_assignments hien co (da doc that: co cac truong assignee, start, end) co du cho yeu cau moi (nhieu nguoi, khoang thoi gian chong lan, FR-16) hay can sua gi; thiet ke bang mau Gantt co dinh 15 mau + cach Leader gan mau cho tung User (khac PIC cu).
4) FR-18 (chong sua trung) ap dung cho nhung bang nghiep vu nao o Lat 4 (projects, project_tasks, weekly_goals...) - cot row_version, quy tac 409.
5) FR-19 (nhat ky) mo rong danh muc hanh dong nghiep vu nao vao audit_log da tao o Lat 3 (xoa project, xoa task, chot tuan, khoa/mo lich...).
6) Neu phat hien mau thuan/lo hong giua CR va code that thi neu ro, de xuat sua, KHONG tu y sua CR trong vong nay.

YEU CAU DAU RA: ban thiet ke ky thuat hoi tu (khong PASS/FAIL): (1) schema ALTER chi tiet, (2) hop dong di tru PIC sang User tung buoc, (3) xac nhan/sua schema assignment + bang mau Gantt, (4) danh sach bang can row_version, (5) danh muc audit moi, (6) danh sach cho con mau thuan/can Leader quyet dinh.
